Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix
Metadata.Note: Fixes corrupted textures in the game by increasing the Video Arena size, allowing the game to use more video memory for textures and effects. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more, or the game crashes. Enable either this patch or one resolution patch, never both.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 480p
Metadata.Note: Decreases game output resolution to 854x480 and increases Video Arena to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 720p
Metadata.Note: Decreases game output resolution to 1280x720 and increases Video Arena to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 1440p
Metadata.Note: Increases game output resolution to 2560x1440 and Video Arena to 2.75 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 3072 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 1800p
Metadata.Note: Increases game output resolution to 3200x1800 and Video Arena to 3.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 4608 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 4K
Metadata.Note: Increases game output resolution to 3840x2160 and Video Arena to approximately 4 GB (3.75 GiB). Requires setting DMEM to 6144 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Frame Rate Patch - 120 FPS
Metadata.Note: Raises the engine maximum framerate from 59.94 to 120 FPS so the frametime clamp produces a 1/120 second gameplay delta. Corrects swing energy calculations to match the original 60 Hz simulation. Requires setting VBlank to 120 FPS.
Metadata.Author: kvicken

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Skip Intro
Metadata.Note: Skips the initial logos. Thanks to illusion0001 aka illusionyy for the PS3 patch which made this very easy.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Skip Any Video With X Button
Metadata.Note: Allows manual skipping of cinematics any cinematic with the X button. Thanks to illusion0001 aka illusionyy for the PS3 patch which made this very easy.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Name: Astra v0.5 - Disable Camera Sway

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v0.7 - Disable Dynamic Shadows - native inactive
Metadata.Note: EXPERIMENTAL; gameplay pending. Partial dynamic shadows only. Keeps native evaluation; forces inactive branch that writes three disabled distance thresholds. No guaranteed FPS gain; not a fix for duplicated effects.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local PS4 binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v0.8 - Job Queue Contention PAUSE
Metadata.Note: L01: PAUSE on failed job queue lock acquisitions only. Same atomic lock and release. Visual settings unchanged. Experimental; no measured gameplay FPS gain.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.0 - Shadow range 75 percent
Metadata.Note: Experimental visual quality option. Scales three published shadow clipping ranges after scene evaluation; retains original bounds. Executable-page padding checked by launcher. Requires compatible loader. No gameplay FPS benefit measured. Do not combine with shadows OFF.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.0 - Shadow range 50 percent
Metadata.Note: Experimental visual quality option. Scales three published shadow clipping ranges after scene evaluation; retains original bounds. Executable-page padding checked by launcher. Requires compatible loader. No gameplay FPS benefit measured. Do not combine with shadows OFF.

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.1 - Particles soft OFF
Metadata.Note: Selects the game native diffuse/specular variants without soft depth intersections. Keeps emitters, lifetime, motion-particle variant, lighting and blending selection. Visual quality tradeoff. Synthetic CPU tests only; gameplay and FPS unmeasured.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.1 - Particles distortion OFF
Metadata.Note: Disables only PS3_RF_DuDvShift material selection, taking its native zero-property path. Keeps PS3_RF_DuDvShift1 motion-particle selection and other feature flags. Visual quality tradeoff. Synthetic CPU tests only; gameplay and FPS unmeasured.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.2 - Automatic particle emission 75 percent
Metadata.Note: Scales automatic visual-emitter rate to 75% before native variance, distance, fractional accumulation and birth spacing. Global: may reduce combat effects. Manual emissions bypassing this routine remain unchanged. Keeps existing particles, lifetime, materials and blending. Requires Astra E10. CPU fixture tests only; visual result and FPS unmeasured. Not a quality-preserving optimization.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.2 - Automatic particle emission 50 percent
Metadata.Note: Scales automatic visual-emitter rate to 50% before native variance, distance, fractional accumulation and birth spacing. Global: may reduce combat effects. Manual emissions bypassing this routine remain unchanged. Keeps existing particles, lifetime, materials and blending. Requires Astra E10. CPU fixture tests only; visual result and FPS unmeasured. Not a quality-preserving optimization.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.3 - SSAO OFF - native preparation retained
Metadata.Note: Retains native preparation/depth pass and final render-target/state restoration. Skips occlusion evaluation, two filtering passes and final color multiplication. Five native draws become one. Removes ambient occlusion: visual tradeoff. Requires Astra E10. CPU control-flow fixture only; GPU, gameplay and FPS unmeasured.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.4 - Native half-resolution particle buffers
Metadata.Note: Selects native mode 1 when the adaptive publisher chooses ordinary mode 0/1. Keeps forced-off guards, owner overrides, cooldown and special modes. Native resource construction uses half-size particle color/depth buffers and the original compositor. No emission/lifetime change and no HDR/exposure resize. Can soften particle edges. Requires Astra E10. Synthetic CPU tests only; FPS/pixels unmeasured.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.5 - Exact SIMD geometry weights
Metadata.Note: Packs four exact F32 skin-weight divisions in native geometry preparation. No reciprocal approximation, FMA, LOD/distance cutoff, geometry removal or quality setting change. 2304 native differential cases passed, including MXCSR flags and special floats. Synthetic CPU routine benchmark only; gameplay and FPS unmeasured. Requires Astra E10.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Astra v1.6 - Authored empty-far LOD threshold 75 percent
Metadata.Note: Only authored two-stage LODs with a nonempty first threshold exactly 100.0 and an empty last 2^31 sentinel stage: changes first threshold to 75.0 before native transition construction. Keeps single-stage models, geometry, special layouts and native fade logic. Objects can disappear earlier. No guarantee of decorative-only classification; no lower-detail mesh is generated. In the sampled assets, 85 groups in 16 OLY300 models qualify. Gameplay and FPS unmeasured. Requires Astra E10.
Metadata.Author: Codex - local binary analysis
